hook_text: Three paper pillars: a circle, a triangle and a square. Stack books on top. Which one wins?
clip_script: Pillar contest in Bethlehem! Three sheets of paper. Roll one into a circle. Fold one into a triangle. Fold one into a square. Same height, same paper. Now stack the books, one at a time. The square buckles. The triangle crumples. The circle? Still standing! No corners, so the weight is shared all the way round. Now roll paper tightly around a kebab stick. That is a strut, ready to build a frame.
visual_style: Whiteboard row of three hollow paper pillars with books stacking on top one by one, then rolled paper tubes joined into a frame.
mood: Tense and fun, like a strength contest.
pacing: Build the three pillars, stack the books, crown the winner, then roll struts for building.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build three paper pillars to test at home.
